title: 第1750章 炼化神瞳第1749章 你的眼睛归我了
slug: 瞎婿第1754章总算找到你了
content_zh:
就在那紫霄雷尊身躯爆炸的一刹那，楚天铭和韩清雪的身影躲入了时空宝玉当中。
轰隆！
紫霄雷尊的身躯化作一道恐怖无比的紫电雷波，席卷整个紫霄雷域，可怕的雷霆之力，引动雷云，无数道紫色闪电，疯狂轰击而下，场面无比恐怖。
不知道过了多久。
那可怕的紫电雷波，才逐渐停了下来，而后楚天铭三人才离开了时空宝玉，重新出现在了外界。
抬眼看去，只见本来整个紫霄雷域，已经是支离破碎，大地被雷电犁出了一道道长达百里的可怕沟壑深谷。
“那个家伙死了？”
杨千珏眨了眨眼睛看向四周，却并没有见到紫霄雷尊的身影。
“这家伙把自己的丹田气海都给爆了，威力足以击杀仙主强者，就算他有不死之身，怕是也难逃一死。”楚天铭淡淡一哼，转身来到了一处空地之上。
韩清雪和杨千珏紧跟在他的身后。
“天铭，紫霄神瞳已经到手，你是不是可以恢复你的六道轮回眼了。”韩清雪神色期待的看向楚天铭。
自从楚天铭眼睛被挖走之后，韩清雪内心便一直痛苦不已，所以对她来说，现在最重要的是事情，就是帮助楚天铭恢复眼睛。
“嗯……应该可以，不过这个过程很漫长，可能要半年，甚至更久，而这段时间，我不能被任何人打扰。”楚天铭转头，面向韩清雪。
“你放心，我不会让任何人打扰你的。”韩清雪信誓旦旦的说道。
“好。”
楚天铭右手一翻，那一双闪烁着紫色雷光的紫霄神瞳，出现在其掌心当中。
“紫霄神瞳，也是四大神瞳之一，若是能够将其转化成六道轮回眼，或许可以让六道轮回眼的能量更强。”
楚天铭深吸一口气，将一双紫色的眼瞳，按在了自己空洞的眼眶当中。
哗！
下一秒！

一阵绚丽的紫色光华，从楚天铭的眼眶当中迸射而出。
楚天铭瞬间感到一股无比霸道的能量，冲入了他的识海，彷佛要将他魂魄都瞬间冲散一般。
“不愧是四大神瞳之一，这股能量果然霸道。”
楚天铭强忍着剧痛，双手掐动法印，运转六道之力，迅速在自己的魂魄四周，形成了一道能量护盾。
那霸道的能量，如同惊涛一般，猛烈的拍打在能量护盾之上，使得那能量护盾震颤不止。
“守魂！”
楚天铭深吸一口气，默默催动着神魂，强大的魂力，瞬间融入到了能量护盾当中。
能量护盾瞬间变得稳固了许多，将那霸道的能量，完全抵挡了下来。
“终于抵挡紫霄神瞳能量的冲击，接下来只需要按部就班，将其能量吸收，应该就可以将紫霄神瞳，转化成我的六道轮回眼了。”
楚天铭想到这里，平静的内心，终于有了一丝丝波澜。
他心里清楚，六道轮回眼，对他有多么重要。
没有这双眼睛，他就无法踏入仙主境界，也就更不可能找那些家伙复仇。
“是时候了！”
楚天铭坚韧的脸庞，闪过一抹决然之色，右手随即猛地拍在了眉心之上。
哗！
一道紫色光柱，顿时冲天而起，将他整个人都吞噬了进去。
content_en:
At the moment when Zixiao Lei Zun's body exploded, the figures of Chu Tianming and Han Qingxue hid in the space-time jade.
Boom!
Zixiao Lei Zun's body turned into a terrifying purple lightning thunder wave, sweeping across the entire Zixiao Thunder Domain. The terrifying power of thunder caused thunder clouds, and countless purple lightnings bombarded down crazily. The scene was extremely terrifying.
I don’t know how long it took.
The terrifying purple lightning thunder waves gradually stopped, and then Chu Tianming and the other three left the Time and Space Jade and reappeared in the outside world.
Looking up, I saw that the entire Zixiao Thunder Domain was already in pieces, and the earth was plowed by thunder and lightning into terrifying ravines and deep valleys that were hundreds of miles long.
"That guy is dead?"
Yang Qianjue blinked and looked around, but did not see Zixiao Lei Zun.
"This guy has exploded his Dantian Qi, which is powerful enough to kill the powerful Immortal Lord. Even if he is immortal, I am afraid he will not be able to escape death." Chu Tianming snorted lightly, turned around and came to an open space.
Han Qingxue and Yang Qianjue followed closely behind him.
"Tian Ming, the Zixiao Divine Eye has been obtained. Can you restore your Six Paths of Samsara Eye?" Han Qingxue looked at Chu Tianming expectantly.
Ever since Chu Tianming's eyes were gouged out, Han Qingxue has been in pain, so for her, the most important thing now is to help Chu Tianming recover his eyes.
"Well... it should be possible, but this process is very long. It may take half a year or even longer, and during this time, I cannot be disturbed by anyone." Chu Tianming turned his head and faced Han Qingxue.
"Don't worry, I won't let anyone disturb you." Han Qingxue said swornly.
"Okay."
Chu Tianming turned his right hand, and a pair of Zixiao Divine Eyes flashing with purple lightning appeared in his palm.
"The Zixiao Divine Eye is also one of the four divine pupils. If it can be transformed into the Six Paths of Samsara Eye, it may be able to make the Six Paths of Samsara Eye even more powerful."
Chu Tianming took a deep breath and pressed a pair of purple eyes into his empty eye sockets.
Wow!
The next second!
A burst of brilliant purple light burst out from Chu Tianming's eyes.
Chu Tianming instantly felt an extremely domineering energy rushing into his sea of ​​consciousness, as if his soul was going to be dispersed in an instant.
"As expected of one of the Four Divine Eyes, this energy is really overbearing."
Chu Tianming endured the severe pain, pinched the seal with both hands, and used the power of the six paths to quickly form an energy shield around his soul.
The domineering energy, like a stormy wave, violently slapped on the energy shield, causing the energy shield to tremble.
"Guard the soul!"
Chu Tianming took a deep breath and silently activated his soul. The powerful soul power was instantly integrated into the energy shield.
The energy shield instantly became much more stable, completely blocking the overbearing energy.
"Finally, I have withstood the impact of the Zixiao Divine Eye's energy. I just need to follow the steps and absorb its energy. I should be able to transform the Zixiao Divine Eye into my Six Paths of Samsara Eye."
When Chu Tianming thought of this, his calm heart finally felt a little disturbed.
He knew in his heart how important the Six Paths of Samsara Eye was to him.
Without these eyes, he would not be able to step into the realm of the Immortal Lord, and it would be even less possible for him to seek revenge from those guys.
"It's time!"
A look of determination flashed across Chu Tianming's tough face, and his right hand suddenly slapped his eyebrows.
Wow!
A purple beam of light suddenly shot up into the sky and swallowed him whole.
